alert.message: OpenClaw gateway status is inconsistent: systemd service reports inactive/dead with last exit 203, while RPC probe is OK and gateway is listening on 127.0.0.1:18789. Service configuration is also flagged as out of date/non-standard with an embedded token.
alert.action: Audit active gateway process ownership, reconcile to a single supported gateway instance, and reinstall the service definition if needed (for example via openclaw gateway install --force after validation).
